fusions.name: Tines Alight
fusions.desc: Tosses the target on burning antlers with your weapon, which deals 12 damage, throws it back 3 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Startle Flash
fusions.desc: A sudden flash of flame that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 15% for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Transfixed
fusions.desc: A glare of firelight holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Quick Hooves
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%, and you have 12% fire resistance.
